SILT#00001: For blood types, the + and - after the letter represent whether you have D antigen for the Rh blood group. There are actually over 50 antigens in the group. There are 4 other common ones: C, c, E, e (yes, the case matters). Whoever is naming the antigens is almost out of English letters
